title: Concept: Profiler link exposed (X-Debug-Token-Link header)
description: The X-Debug-Token-Link header publishes the Symfony profiler URL for the request. The profiler keeps the collected request data behind a debug token, so the header hands out a working read path to configuration, queries and session context.
applicability: Responses produced with the Symfony profiler enabled.
risk: A profiler endpoint addressable by any client exposes per-request internals; MEDIUM severity because the panels routinely include secrets.
